text_live_comments_1_text: Just tried this and actually received mine today. Totally legit.
text_live_comments_2_text: I was skeptical too, but it worked for me.
text_live_comments_3_text: Took a week to arrive. Box had a dent, item fine.
text_comments_1_1: Has anyone here actually received the {_product}? I signed up but I’m cautious.
text_comments_1_2: I thought it was hype too. Did the short quiz, got a confirmation email, and a text the next morning. Package showed up within a week. Box was a bit dented, item fine.
text_comments_1_3: If you don’t see the confirmation, check Spam/Promotions. If it’s been over 7 days since you confirmed, reply to the email you got and we’ll take a look.
text_comments_1_4: Not usually a commenter, but here’s my experience: Went to the page, answered the questions, figured it’s a gimmick. About 5–6 hours later I got a call to confirm my address. Courier asked for a quick signature; I had the {_product} the next day. Honestly surprised.
text_comments_1_5: Thanks for the detailed note. Heads-up for others: some ZIPs require a signature; delivery is typically 3–7 days, sometimes faster.
text_comments_1_6: I left my details yesterday and now I’m worried it’ll never show. Anyone else still waiting on the {_product}?
text_comments_1_7: Totally fair to ask. Shipments go out in batches. Usual timeline is 3–7 days after confirmation. If yours isn’t moving after a week, reply to your confirmation email and we’ll escalate.
text_comments_1_8: Mine looked “stuck” for two days and then arrived this morning. Hang in there.
text_comments_1_9: Didn’t get selected this time. Took two minutes at least. Are there more rounds?
text_comments_1_10: Yes — we run it in waves. If you weren’t selected, you can try again in the next window.
text_comments_1_11: Mine arrived a day late (weather hold per the carrier). Carton looked rough. Inside fine, but if you’re gifting the {_product}, plan an extra day.
text_comments_1_12: Sorry about the delay and the packaging. If you notice any damage beyond the outer box, reply to your confirmation email with photos and we’ll replace it.
